external_source_premise.name: one-dimensional product-marginal density cap
external_source_premise.scope: For independent real coordinates with individual densities bounded by one and a unit coefficient vector supported on an original-coordinate bank, the linear aggregate has density bounded by sqrt(2).
sources: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), Theorem 1.1, arXiv:1507.07949
Rudelson-Vershynin, Small ball probabilities for linear images of high-dimensional distributions, Theorem 1.2; one-dimensional sharp form via Rogozin and Ball

partner_result_applied.application: After two-bank definite smoothing gives residual density cap M, scale the partner theorem from conditional cap one to K_3 and obtain 2 K_3 sqrt(M/|a|) for the final dependent shifted square.

additional_peer_result_applied.application: For the definite two-bank Schur residual S, density cap M <= pi K_1 K_2/sqrt(|det S|).

new_result.statement: For three disjoint original-coordinate unit aggregates Y_r and exact aligned outside coupling Q=Y^T B Y+2Y^T L X_K+X_K^T D X_K, if after permutation B=[[C,b],[b^T,a]], a!=0, has definite Schur complement S=C-bb^T/a, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(pi) K_3 sqrt(K_1 K_2)/(|a det B|)^(1/4) <= 4 sqrt(pi)/(|a det B|)^(1/4).

target_valid_example.dimension_scope: three equal disjoint banks of arbitrary size m; all admissible independent cap-one physical inputs

unresolved_implication: From an arbitrary symmetric matrix with at least three eigenvalues of modulus at least one, either enter the existing diffuse regularized-determinant branch or extract/control disjoint physical aggregates with sufficiently exact bank coupling to invoke the new Schur theorem. Approximate-bank remainder control is unpaid.
next_step: Quantify a heavy-row/near-parallel-bank decomposition and prove that the non-bank quadratic remainder can be retained in the conditioning without destroying the conditional density caps.
